payload.leagueSummary: NET is the whole knife fight right now, and the top of the board is split between dudes who actually ball-strike it and dudes surviving on short-game duct tape. KeithK75, Dan94, and MattF are the cleanest all-around threats, but CRANK keeps sneaking NET wins with a wildly ugly profile: lost off the tee, saved by scrambling, and somehow still annoying everybody. Behind that, the window gets messy fast—BigTime can absolutely stripe it, while several players are dragging around enough bogeys, doubles, and three-putt nonsense to make a simple card look like advanced algebra.
leagueBullets: The best NET profiles are not identical: KeithK75 and Dan94 are full-send tee-to-green wrecking crews, while CRANK is the opposite—weak ball-striking, decent rescue work, and just enough putting to mug the leaderboard.

BigTime’s irons are carrying him like a caddy with a bad back. The approach play is elite enough to contend, but the putter and occasional blow-up hole keep turning sharp rounds into half-melted sandwiches.

The bottom half is a chaos buffet: DREADFUL, HamSammich, and IUDoc92 are all fighting the same disease—too many bogeys, too many doubles, and not enough birdies to cover the bill. Short game can patch a leak; it can’t bail out a whole damn boat.
